subject: Five Phoenix accounts to review for LJ’s Cleaning Solutions
initial_email:
Hi LJ’s Cleaning Solutions team,

Hey, this is Brett with BMC Service Network. We research local commercial accounts so service businesses can spend less time building lists and more time having useful conversations.

Your Phoenix headquarters and commercial cleaning services give this research a clear local starting point.

I put together five Phoenix businesses to review against that scope. For example, The Cavanagh Law Firm has a published local contact route; the brief explains the facility fit and who to ask about vendor onboarding. Each entry includes its business website and a suggested first conversation.

You can keep the five free, as a PDF and an online brief. If the fit is useful, $499 buys 100 total, including those five. These are researched prospects—not businesses that requested a quote—and sales are not guaranteed.

[Button: View my five Phoenix prospects]

Would a different facility type be more useful? Reply with the work you want more of.

Brett
BMC Service Network
contact@bmcservicenetwork.com
BMC Luminary Ventures LLC · 186 E. Sheldon St. #1144, Prescott, AZ 86301

sample.fit_reason: Official business page confirms 1850 N Central Ave Suite 1900, Phoenix, AZ 85004. Law firm publishes a physical Phoenix office and general contact. Ask office administration whether suite cleaning is tenant-controlled and what confidentiality/access procedures apply. Do not use legal intake forms or imply a need for legal services; count firm once. Public contact is a routing contact, not confirmed buying intent. Ask permission to discuss a defined non-specialist cleaning scope; no open job, current outsourcing need or safe access confirmed.
sample.sales_angle: Ask the office manager whether suite cleaning is handled by the practice or the building. Offer a walkthrough and a written scope for reception, restrooms and shared staff areas.
